description.value:
From the day you were old enough to order an ale, you had a favorite stool in every tavern within ten miles of your birthplace. Making the rounds from one inn to the next, you learned to prey on unlucky folk who wanted a comforting lie or two—a fake potion, perhaps, or a forged family tree.

Ability Scores: Dexterity, Constitution, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.feats24.Item.phbftSkilled0000]{Skilled}

Skill Proficiencies: Deception and Sleight of Hand

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulForgeryKit]{Forgery Kit}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulForgeryKit]{Forgery Kit}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCostume0000]{Costume}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, 15 GP; or (B) 50 GP
